text: Night on the savanna. You lie in a tent, a waterhole a few metres in front of you. Crickets chirp, frogs croak at the water's edge, hippos grunt far off. A herd of elephants comes to drink: the deep rumbles they talk with, trunks slurping and splashing water. One stomps past the tent – and once, one comes right up and sniffs at the tent.

gruppen.name: grillen
gruppen.text: Crickets chirping in the grass all around – the calm ground of the scene.

gruppen.name: froesche
gruppen.text: Frogs croak at the edge of the waterhole in front of you.

gruppen.name: ferne
gruppen.text: Distant night sounds from the bush.

gruppen.name: flusspferde
gruppen.text: Far off in the river, hippos grunt, deep and rolling.

gruppen.name: herde
gruppen.text: Four or five elephants stand at the waterhole about 25 metres in front of you, wander slowly along the edge and talk in deep rumbles.

gruppen.name: trinken
gruppen.text: At the waterhole, trunks suck up water, splash and slurp.

gruppen.name: trompete
gruppen.text: Once per loop an elephant in the herd trumpets – loud, but cheerful, not at you.

gruppen.name: vorbeigang
gruppen.text: Once per loop an elephant walks past the tent 8 to 14 metres away: soft, heavy steps, rustling grass, a snort.

gruppen.name: besuch
gruppen.text: Once, a young elephant comes right up to the tent, pulls grass, chews, sniffs at the tent wall with its trunk – and goes back to the herd.

drehbuch: It trots back; the herd moves on.
Crickets, frogs at the water's edge – a herd of elephants approaches, its rumbling coming closer.
One stomps past close to the tent.
The herd is at the waterhole: trunks slurp and splash, deep rumbling.
An elephant trumpets – the frogs fall silent for a moment.
A young elephant comes over, pulls up grass and chews.
It sniffs at the tent wall; even the crickets pause.
